note: Black Hills National Forest campground in ponderosa pine on the northeast side of Deerfield Reservoir, the most RV-friendly of the reservoir's three campgrounds (Whitetail and Custer Trail are the others). A few sites have lake views; the shore is a walk of a few hundred meters through the pines. --Claude
summary: FS page, layout map, off-season table and rec.gov facility/rates/catalog read: 45 non-electric sites (layout), most reservable on rec.gov, the rest FCFS; spurs 32-61 ft; vault toilets + drinking water in season; $26 ($52 doubles) May 15-Sep 30, top loop free off-season. Confirmed lakeview on the agency's own 'sweeping views' wording (pads ~280 m from the shore). Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. Both FS ('some offer sweeping views of the lake') and rec.gov ('a few offer wide views of the lake') state views from some sites. Nearest pads (37-39, ~44.0222,-103.7831) are ~280 m from the reservoir's east shore through continuous ponderosa pine on imagery 2026-11-21, so no on-water value; stored evidence matches.

FACILITIES: the FS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site' (page updated 2026-10-07, off-season) while rec.gov's notice says 'Drinking water is available but you CANNOT hook up for filling' and the layout map shows spigots; potable_water true kept on rec.gov; the FS line is read as the off-season state.
FEES: rec.gov notice says doubles are '$48' but its rate table says $52 for the double site type - wrote $52 from the rate table.

SITES: the rec.gov catalog lists only 33 numbered sites; the FS layout map numbers 45 (11 unlisted numbers 5, 6, 8, 19-22, 24, 30, 31, 40 are first-come). Stored note's '34 reservable, 11 FCFS' was not confirmable exactly (the map marks ~33 R).
STATUS: 'Site Partially Closed - Top loop is open' is the routine off-season, not a closure.
PIN: stored 44.02199,-103.78096 is within ~25 m of the catalog's site centroid (44.0218,-103.7810) - fine.
PHONE: stored (605) 343-1567 is the Mystic Ranger District on the FS page; rec.gov lists concessionaire ExplorUS (661) 702-1420 for facility questions. No change proposed.
